# Bill: AB 902 (2025-2026) — Workplace surveillance tools.

An act to add Part 5.5 (commencing with Section 1560) to Division 2 of the Labor Code, relating to employment.

# Legislative Counsel's Digest

Workplace surveillance tools.

Existing law establishes the Division of Labor Standards Enforcement in the Department of Industrial Relations, and requires the division to enforce labor laws.

This bill would require an employer to provide a worker with advance notice before using a workplace surveillance tool. This bill would prohibit an employer from using such a tool to infer a worker’s protected characteristics.

# Legislative history

2025-02-21 — Introduced. Read first time. To Com. on RLS. for assignment. To print.

2025-03-10 — Referred to Com. on L. & E.

2025-04-23 — From committee: Do pass and re-refer to Com. on APPR. (Ayes 5. Noes 1.) (April 22).

2025-05-23 — Held in committee and under submission.

Current status: In Committee Process

# SECTION 1.

Part 5.5 (commencing with Section 1560) is added to Division 2 of the Labor Code, to read:

1560.

An employer shall provide a worker with notice before using a workplace surveillance tool.
